items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: the first man we played for... was Mr. Adam. Well he had a pavilion... we played on every Saturday

ctx.x: That's they call the Grand Isles, you know? Yeah. Well that same man, what I'm telling you about, he bought a boat. He bought a boat from the Gulf of Mexico. One of them submarine chasers, you know? Oh, that was a fast thing. And he used to charge two dollars a head, see? Well, two dollars a head had two decks. One bottom and the upper deck, you know what I mean? Well he used to do all the gambling down there, you see? So well he used to charge two dollars a head for people to go down. Well most people used to go…
